NO_RESULTS_TEXT: Try a different search or category.
ERROR_GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ERROR_OFFLINE: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection.
ERROR_SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
LOG_OUT_ALL_DEVICES: You will be logged out on all devices.
LOGIN_INTRO: Make offers, send messages and follow your jobs.
REGISTER_INTRO: Post jobs and get offers from pros. If you take on work yourself, turn on pro mode afterwards.
REGISTER_FILL_FIELDS: Enter your name, email and password.
NAME: Name
PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must have at least 8 characters.
HERO_TEXT: From fuse boxes to websites. Describe the job, get offers from local pros and choose the one that suits you.
HERO_TEXT_PRO: Open jobs from people who need help now. Send an offer in a couple of minutes.
SEARCH_PROS: Search for a trade or a pro
CATEGORIES_TITLE: What do you need help with?
NEW_JOBS_TEXT: People who need help right now
STEP_1_TEXT: What needs doing, where and when. It takes a couple of minutes and is free.
STEP_2_TEXT: Pros send you a price. Compare reviews, experience and price.
STEP_3_TEXT: Agree on the details in the chat and approve the work when it's done.
TRUST_REVIEWS: Reviews only come from customers who had the job done
TRUST_VERIFIED: Verified companies are marked with a shield
TRUST_FREE: Free to post, and you decide whether to accept an offer
PRO_INVITE_TITLE: Do you take on jobs yourself?
PRO_INVITE_TEXT: Find jobs nearby, send offers, log hours and invoice the customer from your phone.
NO_OPEN_JOBS_TEXT: New jobs appear here as soon as they're posted.
ADDRESS_PRIVACY_NOTE: The exact address is shown to the pro who gets the job.
LOG_IN_TO_OFFER: Log in to make an offer
OFFER_ALREADY_SENT: You have already sent an offer on this job
ONLY_PROS_CAN_OFFER: Only registered pros can make offers.
CUSTOMER_WAITING_FOR_OFFERS: Pros can now see the job and send you offers.
MESSAGE_TO_CUSTOMER_PLACEHOLDER: What's included, when can you start, have you done similar jobs?
OFFERS_COMPARE_HINT: Compare price, reviews and the message, and accept the one that suits you best.
ACCEPT_OFFER_TEXT: Hire {name} for {price}? The other offers are declined automatically and the job moves to Assigned.
DECLINE_OFFER_TEXT: {name} will be told that the offer was declined.
WITHDRAW_OFFER_TEXT: The customer can no longer accept it. You can send a new offer while the job is open.
OFFER_SENT_WAITING: Offer sent, waiting for the customer
CUSTOMER_CHOOSE_OFFER: {n} offers are waiting for your answer.
MY_OFFERS_GUEST_TEXT: Log in to see the offers you've sent.
NO_OFFERS_SENT_TEXT: Find an open job and send your first offer.
CONTRACT_GUEST_TEXT: Log in to follow the work on your jobs.
APPROVE_STEP_TEXT: Confirm that “{title}” is done the way you agreed.
COMPLETE_JOB_TEXT: All steps are approved. The job is marked as completed and you can leave a review.
WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER_TO_COMPLETE: All steps are approved. Waiting for the customer to complete the job.
WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL: Waiting for the customer to approve
PRO_IS_WORKING: The pro is working on this
SUBMIT_STEP_INTRO: The customer is notified and approves the work or asks for changes. Photos of the finished work help.
NOTE_TO_CUSTOMER_PLACEHOLDER: What was done, anything they should know…
WHAT_SHOULD_CHANGE_PLACEHOLDER: Be specific, so the pro can fix it right away.
REVIEW_INTRO: Your review helps others choose and is shown on the profile.
REVIEW_COMMENT_PLACEHOLDER: How did it go? Quality, communication, keeping to time…
CONTRACT_LINK_PRO: Start steps, add photos and mark the work as done
CONTRACT_LINK_CUSTOMER: See progress, approve the work and complete the job
YOUR_REPLY_PLACEHOLDER: Thank the customer or explain briefly…
REPLY_IS_PUBLIC: Shown publicly under the review. You can reply once.
CAMERA_PERMISSION_DENIED: Allow camera access in Settings to take photos.
PHOTOS_PERMISSION_DENIED: Allow photo access in Settings to choose photos.
TAP_PHOTO_TO_RETRY: Tap the photo to try again.
TIMER_LONG_WARNING: The timer has been running a long time. Forgot to stop it? You can fix the time after stopping.
TIMER_RUNNING_ELSEWHERE: Your timer is running on “{title}”. Stop it there first.
DISCARD_TIMER_TEXT: The time since you started won't be saved.
NO_HOURS_PRO: No hours yet. Start the timer when you begin, or add hours afterwards.
NO_HOURS_CUSTOMER: The pro hasn't logged any hours yet.
WHAT_WAS_DONE_PLACEHOLDER: Shown to the customer and on the invoice
HOURS_TIME_INVALID: Enter a start and end time, for example 08:00 and 15:30.
DELETE_HOURS_TEXT: The entry is removed from the contract.
NOTIFICATIONS_GUEST_TEXT: Log in to get updates on your jobs.
NO_NOTIFICATIONS_TEXT: Offers, approvals and other updates on your jobs show up here.
NOTIF_OFFER_OTHER_CHOSEN: The job went to someone else
INVOICES_GUEST_TEXT: Log in to see your invoices.
SEND_INVOICE_TEXT: {name} gets an invoice of {total}. It gets a number and KID, and can't be changed afterwards.
DELETE_DRAFT_TEXT: Any hours on it can be invoiced again later.
NO_BANK_ACCOUNT_WARNING: Your company has no bank account set up, so the invoice won't say where to pay.
NO_INVOICES_PRO_TEXT: Create an invoice from a contract: from the logged hours or the agreed price.
NO_INVOICES_CUSTOMER_TEXT: Invoices from pros you've hired show up here.
INVOICE_NEEDS_A_LINE: The invoice needs at least one line.
INVOICE_LINE_INVALID: Every line needs a description, a quantity and a price.
NO_HOURS_TO_INVOICE: There are no new billable hours to invoice.
NO_INVOICES_HOURLY: No invoices yet. “Invoice the hours” makes a draft from all hours that haven't been invoiced.
NO_INVOICES_FIXED: No invoices yet. “New invoice” makes a draft with the agreed price that you can change before sending.
BECOME_PRO_PROFILE_TEXT: Register your company and start sending offers, logging hours and invoicing. It takes a couple of minutes.
PHONE_HINT: Shown to the pro or customer you work with.
EMAIL_CANNOT_CHANGE: Your email is used to log in and can't be changed here.
BECOME_PRO_GUEST_TEXT: Create an account or log in first, then set up your company.
ALREADY_A_PRO_TEXT: Your company is set up. You can change what you do and where you work in your pro profile.
BECOME_PRO_COMPANY_TEXT: Customers see the company name. The rest is used on your offers and invoices.
BECOME_PRO_SERVICES_TEXT: This is what customers see when they look for help.
BECOME_PRO_AREA_REMOTE: You work remotely, so customers from all of Norway can find you.
BECOME_PRO_AREA_TEXT: We show you to customers and jobs within this area.
BECOME_PRO_VISIBLE_NOTE: When you finish, customers can find your profile. You can hide it at any time.
COMPANY_READ_ONLY: Only the owner and administrators can change the company.
INVOICE_FOOTER_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Registered in the Register of Business Enterprises
NO_PRO_PROFILE_TEXT: Set up your company and profile to get jobs.
VISIBLE_ON_TEXT: Customers can find you and see your profile.
VISIBLE_OFF_TEXT: Hidden. You won't show up in searches, but you can still send offers.
ORG_NUMBER_INVALID: That number isn't right. Check for typos.
ORG_NUMBER_REQUIRED_AS: A limited company (AS) needs an organisation number.
BANK_ACCOUNT_INVALID: That account number isn't right. Check for typos.
ORG_NUMBER_HINT: 9 digits, from the Brønnøysund Register Centre
BANK_ACCOUNT_HINT: 11 digits. Shown on your invoices so customers know where to pay.
HEADLINE_REQUIRED: Write a short headline (at least 5 characters).
HOURLY_RATE_INVALID: Enter the rate in NOK, for example 850.
WHAT_DO_YOU_DO_HINT: Choose everything you take on. Customers search by these.
HEADLINE: Headline
HEADLINE_PLACEHOLDER: Electrician in Bergen, 15 years of experience
ABOUT_YOU_PLACEHOLDER: Experience, certificates, what you're good at…
HOURLY_RATE_HINT: Optional. Shown as “from X kr/h” on your profile.
POSTCODE_LOOKUP_FAILED: Couldn't look up the postcode right now. You can carry on; customers just won't see your distance.
POST_JOB_INTRO: The more specific you are, the better offers you get.
POST_JOB_GUEST_TEXT: Log in to post the job and get offers.
JOB_TITLE_PLACEHOLDER: Replace the fuse box in a detached house
JOB_DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: Size, materials, access, when it suits you…
STREET_ADDRESS_HINT: Only shown to the pro you choose.
JOB_TITLE_TOO_SHORT: Give the job a title of at least 5 characters.
JOB_CITY_REQUIRED: Enter where the job will be done.
BUDGET_MIN_OVER_MAX: The budget "from" must be lower than "to".
NO_PROS_YET_TEXT: Pros who take on jobs are shown here.
VERIFIED_BRREG: Verified in the Brønnøysund Register Centre
LOG_IN_TO_MESSAGE: Log in to send a message
MESSAGES_GUEST_TEXT: Log in to send messages about jobs and agree on details.
NO_MESSAGES_TEXT: Conversations about jobs show up here.
MESSAGE_FAILED: Not sent. Tap to try again.
CHAT_EMPTY_TEXT: Send {name} a message about the job, timing or price.
PROFILE_GUEST_TEXT: Log in to post jobs, make offers and follow your jobs.
MY_JOBS_GUEST_TEXT: Log in to see your jobs.
NO_JOBS_TEXT: Describe what needs doing, and pros will send you offers.
NO_ASSIGNMENTS_TEXT: Find open jobs and send offers.
PRO_MODE_ON: You see the app as a pro
PRO_MODE_OFF: You see the app as a customer
AMOUNT_INVALID: Write an amount in NOK, e.g. 5000.
EMAIL_INVALID: That email address doesn't look right.
CLIENTS_PRO_ONLY: Your own client register is for pros. Log in with a pro account to use it.
NO_CLIENTS_TEXT: Add the customers you work for outside the marketplace, and keep jobs, hours and invoices for them in one place.
NO_ARCHIVED_CLIENTS_TEXT: Clients you archive end up here, with their old jobs and invoices.
CLIENT_FORM_INTRO: Only you and your company can see this. The address is used as the work address on new jobs.
CLIENT_NOTES_PLACEHOLDER: Gate code, parking, the dog's name…
CLIENT_NOTES_HINT: Only for you and your colleagues, never shown to the client.
CLIENT_NO_DETAILS: No contact details yet. Tap Edit to add them.
CLIENT_NO_JOBS: No jobs for this client yet.
ARCHIVE_CLIENT_TEXT: The client has jobs, so they're kept with their jobs and invoices. You can restore them later.
NEW_ASSIGNMENT_INTRO: Register work for your own client and agree the price. You can add steps, log hours and invoice from the contract.
ASSIGNMENT_DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: What's agreed, materials, anything the client should know
END_BEFORE_START: The end date is before the start date.
STEPS_OPTIONAL_HINT: Optional. Without steps the whole job is one step.
STEPS_SPLIT_HINT: Each step is approved separately. The amounts must add up to the price.
STEPS_HOURLY_HINT: Each step is approved separately. The hours are logged on the contract.
STEPS_MUST_ADD_UP: The steps must add up to {total}.
STEPS_ADD_UP: The steps add up to the price ✓
STEPS_TOTAL_MISMATCH: The steps add up to {steps}, the agreed price is {total}.
ADD_STEP_INTRO: The customer approves each step when it's done.
STEP_STARTED_NO_DELETE: This step has started, so it can be changed but not deleted.
JOB_HAS_CONTRACT: This job already has a contract.
JOB_NOT_YOURS: Only the one who created the job can change it.
JOB_CANNOT_EDIT: Someone is already hired, so the job can't be changed any more.
EDIT_JOB_INTRO: Pros see the changes straight away.
EDIT_JOB_WITH_OFFERS: Offers received: {n}. Tell the pros about big changes in the chat, so their offers still fit.
DRAFT_NOT_VISIBLE: This is a draft. Pros can't see it until you publish it.
CANCEL_JOB_TEXT: The job is taken down and can't be reopened.
CANCEL_JOB_WITH_OFFERS_TEXT: The job is taken down, and the pros who sent offers ({n}) are told it was cancelled.
DELETE_JOB_TEXT: The draft is deleted for good.
CANCEL_CONTRACT_INTRO: The work stops here. Approved steps and invoices are kept, and the other side is told.
CANCEL_REASON_PLACEHOLDER: A few words both of you can see later
COMPLETE_CLIENT_JOB_TEXT: All steps are signed off. The job is marked as completed.
SIGN_ON_SITE_INTRO: Let the customer check the work and sign with a finger on the screen. This approves the step.
CHANGE_PASSWORD_INTRO: You stay logged in here. Your other phones and browsers are logged out.
PASSWORD_SAME_AS_OLD: Choose a password you haven't used here.
NO_PAYMENTS_TEXT: Payments made through the app show up here. Jobs paid by invoice are under Invoices.
TEAM_ROW_HINT: The people working in the company
TEAM_MANAGE_HINT: Colleagues need a Qup Work account first. Tap someone to change or remove them.
TEAM_WORKER_HINT: The owner and admins add and remove colleagues.
ADD_MEMBER_INTRO: Use the email they signed up to Qup Work with.
MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: Nobody has signed up with that email yet. Ask them to create an account first.
MEMBER_ALREADY: That person is already in the company.
ROLE_ADMIN_HINT: Admins can change the company details and invoice settings, and add colleagues.
ROLE_WORKER_HINT: Workers see the company's jobs, log hours and do the work.
REMOVE_MEMBER_TEXT: {name} no longer sees the company's jobs and clients.
LEAVE_COMPANY_TEXT: You no longer see {name}'s jobs and clients.
INVOICE_NO_EMAIL: Sent, but not emailed: the client has no email address. Open the PDF and share it yourself, or use Email invoice.
INVOICE_EMAIL_NOT_SET_UP: Sent, but not emailed: email isn't set up on the server yet (RESEND_API_KEY).
SEND_INVOICE_NO_EMAIL: There's no email address, so it won't be emailed. You can share the PDF yourself.
NOTIF_JOB_INVITED: You were invited to a job
JOB_ALERTS_ON_TEXT: You get a notification when a job in your categories is posted in your area.
JOB_ALERTS_OFF_TEXT: You won't be notified about new jobs, but you can still browse them in the app.
JOB_ALERTS_NEEDS_VISIBLE: Turn on visibility first. Only pros customers can find get job alerts.
